hero.body: Session Manager is a desktop app that bolts onto Claude Code and gives it a proper garage: sessions that don't lose the plot, a scheduler that waits out your token limit for you, and every setting in one friendly window. The app runs on your own laptop.

tabs.title: Hit your token limit? Queue it and go get lunch.
tabs.body: The scheduler watches your usage window and starts queued jobs whenever there's room — and if you hit the limit, it pauses and picks back up at the reset.
